data.name: Regulars
data.detailed_description:
They always come back. But sometimes, something else comes with them.

Overcooked's chaos. Among Us's paranoia. A diner that closes at midnight for a reason.

Regulars is a cooperative restaurant management game set during the night shift of a small sit-down diner. Seat customers, take their orders, prep ingredients across grill, fryer, and assembly stations, and serve meals before patience runs thin. You're understaffed and the door keeps opening.

But the real job isn't cooking.

Your regulars are creatures of habit.  Learn their faces, their quirks, their tells. Because tonight, something walked in wearing a familiar face, and it's sitting at table four asking for the usual.

Spot the difference. Make the call.

Scales, thermometers, dermal scanners, UV lamps — use your tools to investigate the customers who don't quite add up. Cross-reference what you see against your notebook. Follow the rules posted on the board. And when you're sure something isn't right... pull the trigger. Be wrong, and you've just shot a paying customer.

Features

- Co-op for 1–8 players — Host online through relay or over LAN. Every role matters when the diner gets busy.

- Learn your regulars — Dozens of unique customer profiles with consistent behaviors, preferences, and appearances that you'll memorize over time.

- Cook real orders — Grill, fry, prep, plate, and serve from a menu of 85+ recipes with multi-ingredient assembly.

- Investigate anomalies — Tier-gated inspection tools reveal what the naked eye can't. Daily rules change what "normal" looks like each shift.

- Upgrade your diner — Unlock faster equipment, more seating, advanced info tools, and automation as your restaurant levels up.

- Customize your character — Full character creator with face, hair, clothing, and accessories.

- First-person or third-person — Toggle your camera perspective at any time.

- Full controller support — Play with keyboard & mouse or gamepad.

data.short_description: Run a late-night diner with up to 8 friends. Seat customers, take orders, and cook meals. Not everyone is who they seem. Study your regulars, spot the anomalies, and decide who gets served and who gets purged.

content_descriptors.notes: Regulars is a cooperative multiplayer restaurant game with a supernatural mystery theme. Players operate a diner during night shifts, seating customers, taking orders, and identifying supernatural anomalies disguised as regular patrons. Suspected anomalies can be "purged" via weapon in a cartoonish, non-graphic manner — characters simply disappear with no blood or violence depicted. The game contains no sexual content, nudity, drug/alcohol use, self-harm, or graphic violence. The tone is lighthearted suspense similar to "Among Us" or "Papers, Please," with tension coming from observation and deduction rather than horror.
